ModMetaData.name: Highlight Corpses With Tech
ModMetaData.author: Phil DeLuca
ModMetaData.description:
Marks corpses that still carry recoverable bionics and implants, so you can tell at a glance which bodies are worth hauling to a harvesting bench and which are already-stripped shells.
Qualifying corpses get a pulsing light-blue outline tracing the body, and an alert that names each corpse and what is on it. Clicking the alert cycles the camera through them. The outline brightens with the tech tier, so a rich corpse is distinguishable from a marginal one at a glance.
Which tech tiers count is configurable - one checkbox per tier, from peg legs up to archotech. The default is Industrial and up, so simple prosthetics count and peg legs do not.
A qualifying corpse's name is also drawn in the same pulsing blue wherever it appears in a cargo, caravan, transport or trade list, so you can pick the body worth taking out of a long manifest.
Detection uses only vanilla API. It declares no dependency on any implant-recovery mod, though one is what makes this useful.
